g1.flow: Word for word the same: inna hādhihi tadhkiratun, fa-man shāʾa ttakhadha ilā rabbihi sabīlā. Know them by the neighbours. Al-Muzzammil (page 574): after the heaven breaking apart, before the long ayah 'your Lord knows you stand at night'. Al-Insān (page 580): after 'We created them and strengthened their forms', before 'you do not will except that Allāh wills'. Hook: sky then night prayer; creation then Allāh's will.

cues.73:19: Al-Muzzammil: after the heaven breaking apart; next, the long ayah on standing at night.
cues.76:29: Al-Insān: after 'We created them and strengthened their forms'; next, 'you do not will'.
